messages:
Marta: kicking off canary for matrix-ops-quant v3 in night window us-west-2, 5% traffic via deploy-bot now.

deploy-bot: \u23f3 starting rollout matrix-ops-quant@v3 -> pool: runtime-gpu-2 slice=5%

Sahil: can we enable detailed traces for this run? need per-op latency + fallback counters.

Marta: adding flags: `--trace=matmul_v3-canary --telemetry=debug`

Cheng: quick question: does v3 prefer int8-path with fused kernels? last int8 rollout had KV-cache coldstart regressions for long sequences.

Marta: yes, v3 adds int8 fused kernels and an adaptive selector. small-batch micro-optimizations included.

Olivia: ops note: change window 22:00-03:00 UTC. rollback hard window 02:10-02:30 if >5% errors or p95 >+35% baseline.

Sahil: traces coming in. p50 looks fine, p95 elevated for seq>1000 (about +25%). attaching sample log.

Sahil: ```
[matmul_v3-canary] 1767654388 TRACE matmul kernel:int8_fused seq=1280 latency=420ms baseline=320ms
[matmul_v3-canary] 1767654390 WARN fp32_fallback=true reason=overflow_check host=172.31.9.18
```

Cheng: that host is still on driver 510. long-tail fallbacks expected. can we query which hosts hit fallback>0?

Marta: deploy-bot, run host diag filter telemetry.matmul_v3.fallback_count>0 since 1767654300.

deploy-bot: `diag --pool runtime-gpu-2 --filter "telemetry.matmul_v3.fallback_count>0" --since 1767654300` -> hosts: 172.31.9.12 (count=1), 172.31.9.18 (count=2), 172.31.9.21 (count=1) all on driver 510. recommendation: cordon or move canary off these hosts.

Olivia: ops can cordon them now; those hosts were scheduled for driver upgrade later this week.

Sahil: recommend re-run canary on nodes with driver>=530 only. also pin prod route back to v2-stable while we validate.

Marta: agree. plan: 1) cordon affected hosts, 2) pin prod to matrix-ops-quant@v2-stable (ttl=30m), 3) run 5% canary on driver>=530 nodes, 4) observe 30m smoke, 5) proceed or rollback.

Olivia: cordoning hosts now.

deploy-bot: mark-cordon 172.31.9.12 172.31.9.18 172.31.9.21 -> SUCCESS

Marta: routing pinned to v2-stable.

deploy-bot: route-pin matrix-ops-quant -> matrix-ops-quant@v2-stable ttl=30m -> SUCCESS

Sahil: prod metrics back to baseline after pin (~2m). starting targeted shadow canary on driver>=530 pool.

Cheng: add immediate rollback doc entry in release notes capturing driver incompatibility and mitigation steps.

Marta: DRAFT release note: "matrix-ops-quant v3 introduced fused int8 matmul kernels. Canary revealed fp32 fallbacks on hosts with NVIDIA driver 510 causing p95 latency regressions. Mitigation: cordon affected hosts, pin production to v2-stable, re-run canary on driver>=530. Action: schedule driver upgrades and revalidate before resuming rollout."

Olivia: include diag links and trace ids in the note.

Marta: added links: https://telemetry.internal/runs/1767654388 https://diag.internal/176765/hosts

Sahil: gating proposal: if shadow canary on >=530 shows p95 <= +10% and fallback_count ~0 over 30m, proceed with gradual rollout. else keep pin and expand driver patch. If customer errors >1% open postmortem.

Cheng: agreed. also add infra ticket reference.

Olivia: creating ticket INF-1284 for driver upgrade, target patch window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC, ETA 36h.

Marta: summary: cordoned 3 hosts, prod pinned to v2-stable, canary paused on older drivers. follow-ups: INF-1284, re-run canary on upgraded nodes, update changelog.

Sahil: thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout paused matrix-ops-quant@v3 (reason: host-driver-incompatibility)
